title: LIQUOR SCREEN EFFECT HALVED
why: His order of 2026-10-15: one shot of liquor is too intense on the effects, turn it down. The drunk warp, sway and menu wobble are driven by one strength number that topped out at 8.5; it tops out at 4.25 now, so one shot draws half the warp it did and a whole stack is half as wild. Blotter, the staggering veer, the slow-down and the experience bonus are unchanged.
now: A shot of liquor now bends the screen half as much.
